pages.why_title: VRLA or lithium-ion, sized for your room.
pages.why_text: VRLA batteries are the lower-cost, long-standing choice, but they wear out faster in hot rooms. Lithium-ion takes less space, tolerates heat better and lasts longer, at a higher purchase price. We recommend and size the battery around your load, the runtime you need and the room it sits in.
